Here are the teams that have captured the NBA championship in each of the last five completed seasons (2020‑21 through 2024‑25).  

| Season | Champion | Year the Finals concluded |
|--------|----------|----------------------------|
| 2020‑21 | **Milwaukee Bucks** | 2021 |
| 2021‑22 | **Golden State Warriors** | 2022 |
| 2022‑23 | **Denver Nuggets** | 2023 |
| 2023‑24 | **Boston Celtics** | 2024 |
| 2024‑25 | *(champion not yet recorded in the sources I can access)* | 2025 |

**Quick recap of each title run**

| Team | Opponent in the Finals | Series result | Notable MVP |
|------|------------------------|--------------|-------------|
| Milwaukee Bucks | Phoenix Suns | 4‑2 | Giannis Antetokounmpo (Finals MVP) |
| Golden State Warriors | Boston Celtics | 4‑2 | Stephen Curry (Finals MVP) |
| Denver Nuggets | Miami Heat | 4‑1 | Nikola Jokić (Finals MVP) |
| Boston Celtics | Golden State Warriors | 4‑2 | Jayson Tatum (Finals MVP) |
| 2024‑25 | — | — | — |

*The 2024‑25 NBA Finals concluded in June 2025, but the publicly available reference data I can query at the moment does not yet list the champion. If you need the most recent winner, a quick check of the NBA’s official site or a current news source will provide the answer.*
